entries.title: Proverbs 21:1
segments: The king's heart [is] in the hand of the LORD [as] the rivers of water; He turns it wherever He will.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:2
segments: Every way of a man [is] right in his own eyes, but the LORD ponders the hearts.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:3
segments: To do justice and judgment [is] more pleasing to the LORD than sacrifice.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:4
segments: A high look, a proud heart, [and] the plowing of the wicked, [is] sin.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:5
segments: The thoughts of the diligent [tend] only to plenty; but the thoughts of everyone [who is] hasty only to poverty.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:6
segments: The getting of treasures by a lying tongue [is] a vanity tossed to and fro by those who seek death.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:7
segments: The robbery of the wicked shall destroy them, because they refuse to do judgment.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:8
segments: The way of a guilty man [is] perverted; but the pure, his work [is] right.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:9
segments: [It is] better to dwell in a corner of the housetop than [with] a quarrelsome woman and to share a house.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:10
segments: The soul of the wicked desires evil; his neighbor finds no favor in his eyes.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:11
segments: When the scorner is punished, the simple is made wise; and when the wise is instructed, he receives knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:12
segments: The righteous wisely considers the house of the wicked; [but God] overthrows the wicked for [their] wickedness.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:13
segments: Whoever stops his ears at the cry of the poor, he also shall cry himself, but shall not be heard.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:14
segments: A gift in secret quiets anger; and a bribe in the bosom quiets strong wrath.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:15
segments: [It is] joy to the just to do judgment, but ruin [shall be] to the workers of iniquity.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:16
segments: The man who wanders out of the way of understanding shall rest in the assembly of departed spirits.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:17
segments: He who loves pleasure [shall be] a poor man; he who loves wine and oil shall not be rich.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:18
segments: The wicked [shall be] a ransom for the righteous, and the transgressor for the upright.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:19
segments: [It is] better to dwell in the wilderness than with a quarrelsome and angry woman.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:20
segments: A desirable treasure and oil [are] in the home of the wise; but a foolish man swallows it up.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:21
segments: He who follows after righteousness and mercy finds life, righteousness, and honor.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:22
segments: A wise one scales the city of the mighty and brings down the strength of its hope.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:23
segments: Whoever keeps his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:24
segments: Proud, haughty scorner [is] his name, he who deals in proud wrath.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:25
segments: The desire of the lazy man kills him, for his hands have refused to work.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:26
segments: He covets greedily all the day long; but the righteous gives and spares not.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:27
segments: The sacrifice of the wicked [is] hateful to God; how much more [when] he brings it with a wicked mind?

entries.title: Proverbs 21:28
segments: A false witness shall perish, but the man who hears speaks on and on.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:29
segments: A wicked man hardens his face, but the upright establishes his way.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:30
segments: [There is] no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the LORD.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:31
segments: The horse [is] prepared for the day of battle; but safety [is] from the LORD.
